game_reported.title: {opponent} submitted game {game}
game_reported.body: {tournament}: confirm or dispute by {deadline}. Without a response, the game counts.

game_contested.title: Game disputed
game_contested.body: {tournament}: {player} disputed game {game}. Resolve it in the match.

contest_received.title: {player} disputed game {game}
contest_received.body: {tournament}: accept and correct the score, or the organizers will resolve it.

contest_accepted.title: {player} accepted your dispute
contest_accepted.body: {tournament}: check the score for game {game}. If it's still wrong, dispute it again.

veto_started.title: The veto has started
veto_started.body: {tournament}: against {opponent}. If a step's time runs out, the pick is drawn at random.

team_pick_open.title: Pick your champions
team_pick_open.body: {tournament}: one champion for each game in the match. Whatever is missing at the end is drawn at random.

tie_pending.title: Tie to decide
tie_pending.body: {tournament}: the matches ended with a tie in the standings. Decide the order.

deletion_due.title: {tenant} will be deleted
deletion_due.body: To keep the community, cancel the deletion in settings by {deadline}.

push.title: Notifications with the site closed
push.description: Check-in open, match ready, and game submitted by the opponent. For organizers, also game disputed.
push.off: Turned off in this browser. Each device is turned on separately.
push.failed: Couldn't change notifications in this browser. Try again.
push.denied: To turn them on, allow notifications for this site in your browser settings (the icon next to the address bar) and reload the page.
push.unsupported: This browser doesn't receive notifications with the site closed.
push.installTitle: On iPhone and iPad, install the site first.
push.install: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Then open the site from the new icon and turn it on here.
push.prompt: Get alerted about what happens in the tournament, like your match being ready, even with the site closed.
push.promptInstall: To get notifications on iPhone with the site closed, install the site via Share → Add to Home Screen.
push.enabled: Notifications turned on in this browser.
